description:
Ready to create a smarter world? Join the future of Innovation. Join NXP. 
 
 NXP Semiconductors enables secure connections and infrastructure for a smarter world, advancing solutions that make lives easier, better and safer. As the world leader in secure connectivity solutions for embedded applications, we are driving innovation in the secure connected vehicle, end-to-end security & privacy and smart connected solutions markets.  Built on more than 60 years of combined experience and expertise, the company has 45,000 employees in more than 35 countries. Additional information can be found by visiting  www.nxp.com .

We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic AI Software developer. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic semiconductor environment, supporting and maintaining critical software systems.
 
 We expect 
 Experience with Python (and writing production software in Python) . Familiarity with software engineering best practices. 
 Nice-to-have J ava S cript /T ype S cript/React experience or minor-scale GUI/UI/UX development. 
 Academical background or e xperience with neural networks or machine learning algorithms. 
 Nice-to-have experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch or with compiler technologies. 
 Passion for artificial intelligence, machine learnin g, smart devices, agentic systems or similar. 
 Curious and innovative thinking . R esponsibility for meeting goals and deadlines. 
 
 We offer 
 Work in a n awarded team with high energy , an open collaboration environment and eagerness for continuous improvement. 
 Experience in a multinational world-leading semiconductor company​. 
 Work with the latest innovations and become a contributor to state-of-the-art technologies in the field of artificial intelligence. 
 Opensource contributions to the World ’ s leading repositories on GitHub. 
 Co-develop technologies used by hardware in state-of-the-art devices by our customers such as smart glasses, self-driving cars or in medical/industrial segments 
 
 Job summary 
 Develop tools , libraries and algorithms in Python for optimizing neural network models for embedded and mobile devices. 
 Develop tools in Python to deploy, profile, benchmark neural network models on embedded and mobile devices 
 Contribute to opensource (e. g., PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow or other popular opensource communities ). 
 Enable audio, vision, generative AI and/or l anguage models on mobile and embedded devices. 
 Explore latest research and technologies . Implement proof-of-concepts or invent something of your own, and pursue a paper or a patent. Present your work on World's leading software conferences. 
 Co-develop hardware / software of state-of-the-art artificial intelligence accelerators. 
 
 AI Software R&D Team 
 A well-established team working together for 5 + years responsible for a complete SW portfolio of artificial intelligence products , ranging from runtime libraries to an SDK featuring optimization algorithms, and neural network deployment tooling. 
 Responsible for design and development of AI-related SW products across PC , mobile and embedded platforms. 
 Contributions to research , innovation, patents and opensource software. 
 Distributed across multiple countries – US, Romania, China, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, France, Canada, Mexico, Czech Republic and cooperating with other international teams. Communication in English. 
 The Czech team is based in Brno and currently has 10 team members ranging from juniors/interns to experienced senior /principal developers. 
 The team is part of the AI Software R&D department being at the heart of research and software development of NXP 
 
 What Can You Expect? 
 📝 Contract Type 
This role is offered as a full‑time position with a permanent contract, providing long‑term stability and room for growth.
 
 📚 Development Opportunities 
We believe that growing our people is key to growing our business. That’s why we offer a mix of online and offline learning opportunities to help you sharpen both your technical and soft skills.
 
 ⭐ Compensation 
 Attractive market salary is accompanied by the bonus plan (payment twice a year), long-term incentive plan and dividends processing, opportunity to purchase company shares at a 15% discount, lunch allowance, additional vacation days, sickness support, sick days, weekend bank holiday recovery days, pension and well-being support, flexible work hours, home office, team-buildings, and much more. Salaries are being reviewed each year, and market changes are closely observed.
 We believe in providing a holistic and supportive work environment, and we would be happy to share more details during our face-to-face discussions.
 
 🏢 Our Offices 
We work in two locations – each with its own vibe:
 Brno : A modern office with a fresh design, cozy rooms, and an in-house cafeteria.

 Rožnov : A place with history and heart. A modern office with fresh design, and an in-house cafeteria. We love the relaxed atmosphere of the town and the wide selection of great restaurants, perfect for enjoying lunch with colleagues.

 
 🚀 Hiring Process 
Applying is quick and easy – just fill out the online form and upload your CV.
If your profile matches, you’ll have a short phone or video call with our technical team. If successful, you’ll get a chance to ask HR anything you need. We respond fast — unless we’re on vacation 😊.
 
 🌟 And More... Life at NXP 
Work is important, but so is everything around it. We start our days with free coffee and friendly chats. You can look forward to fresh fruit days, ice cream breaks, and even bake fairs.
We also organize social events like Christmas parties, family days, and food festivals. Want to give back? Join our charity initiatives and help us make a difference.
 
 ⏭️ What’s next 
 If you’re excited about this opportunity, we kindly invite you to apply!
 Candidates are invited to apply with the resume and motivation letter in English.
 At the application stage, all candidates should have a valid visa and work permit to work in Czech Republic.
 If you have any questions, we are happy to answer them. Please contact:
 Milana Stojsavljevic, Talent Acquisition Specialist - milana.stojsavljevic@nxp.com 
 
 Please note: The successful candidate may/will be responsible for security related tasks. The assignment may/will be in scope of security certifications, therefore a conscious and reliable way of working is necessary .
 
 More information about NXP in Czech Republic...
